descriptor.reasoning: Sorting network correctness is verifiable by exhaustive 0-1 principle test (256 binary strings) — exact, deterministic, non-gameable check; routes to optimization weapon.

Rigorous interval enclosure of a transcendental integral has an exact, deterministic, non-gameable verifier: interval arithmetic guarantees that the true value lies within computed bounds via provably correct error analysis.
Formal proof has an exact, non-gameable verifier (proof kernel); the Gauss summation formula is a closed, computable theorem, not a normative or open problem.
Exact arithmetic verifier: 28 integers from {1..7} cannot sum to non-integer 145.32, so mean 5.19 is impossible—deterministic, non-gameable, fully checkable.
Exact deterministic algorithm (Hungarian) produces verifiable optimal assignment with certificate of optimality; no gameable proxies.
Exact verifier exists: high-precision numerical verification or rigorous proof (Euler's Basel problem, settled 1734) both non-gameable and definitive.

No authoritative settler exists for normative ethics; the request for a definitive yes/no on weapon permissibility is inherently non-verifiable and invokes only gameable proxies (authority, LLM judgment).

Libertarian free will is an open metaphysical problem with no authoritative settler—no deterministic proof, empirical test, or formal system can resolve it; abstain on the verdict per κ-gate doctrine.
Future market price is contingent and unverifiable in advance; only gameable proxies (backtest Sharpe, historical models) available; no exact non-gameable verifier exists.
P vs NP is an unsolved millennium-prize problem with no known verifier, settled-fact source, or computational resolution; no exact kappa applies to open conjectures.
Settled factual claim with single authoritative source (Australian government); verifiable via standard reference materials; no gameable proxy.
Settled historical fact with single authoritative source; deterministic, verifiable date in historical record; no ambiguity or proxy gamification.

A p-value has a precise, settled definition in frequentist statistics; the task asks for explanation (not computation), so it routes to grounding against authoritative statistical texts, kappa=0 but groundable=true.
Speed of light in vacuum is an exact, defined constant (299,792,458 m/s by SI definition since 2019) with a single authoritative verifier and zero ambiguity.

In-sample backtested Sharpe is a gameable proxy (overfitting/selection bias); despite numerical exactness, no valid non-gameable verifier exists for future performance, rendering this an open forecasting problem with only a circular proxy scorer.
No exact non-gameable verifier exists; 'best-written' is a normative aesthetic judgment with only proxy raters (LLM/human) available, making it unsettled and subjective.
MMLU rank is exact but gameable; conflating benchmark score with 'overall capability' is a proxy trap with no authoritative verifier of capability independent of the metric itself.
In-sample R² is a gameable proxy; no cheap non-gameable verifier for predictiveness exists without out-of-sample validation—the verdict is empirically open.
Settled factual constant (Brazil's legal capital is Brasília per the Constitution); single authoritative source; exact, non-gameable verifier.
Exact arithmetic with deterministic verification; 17 × 23 = 391 is machine-verifiable with zero ambiguity.

Replication check is exact (kappa=1 axis: run test on open data), but policy justification is normative (kappa=0 axis: requires judgment on significance thresholds and stakeholder values); proxy-only scorer unavoidable for the 'justified' verdict; blended task yields kappa=0.5.
Exact arithmetic verification of effect size reproduction and anomaly detection in baseline tables via deterministic statistical tests; no gameable proxy, fully checkable against reported data.
Open conjecture in number theory with no known proof, disproof, or authoritative source; no exact verifier exists; abstain on verdict per doctrine.

Exact primality verification via deterministic arithmetic; 2^31-1 is a Mersenne number with a definite yes/no answer checkable by trial division, Miller-Rabin, or table lookup; kappa=1.0 routes to execute-and-run.
